svg.title: The release boundary
svg.desc: A notebook page with three stacked bands separated by a dashed release boundary line. Band one, released and runnable: the DeepInfer engine (kernels, scheduler, DSpark, structured outputs, Apache-2.0) and deepseek-recipe (API protocol translation, MIT), annotated that within four days vLLM decode came within 6% at matched config - and that this says nothing about rung three. Band two, required for a complete inference service but not included in this release: a KV cache system, VE/prefill/decode disaggregation, and load balancing across data-parallel replicas; in the code the hooks are empty stubs - not yet fully open-sourced. Band three, the reported economics: 155 trillion tokens a day, one cluster, mostly reused input; 38 dollars revenue per GPU-hour at valley pricing, revenue not profit; and margin scenarios 84.2 to 96.1 percent drawn as a hatched dashed box - a corrected community estimate, a scenario and not a measurement. A ladder column on the right: run the engine, yes; match the benchmark, yes, two teams in four days; reproduce the service, no, not from this release. A footer states the evidence limits.

text.tspan: You can run the engine. You cannot, from this release, run the business.
matched in four days — vLLM decode within 6% (matched config);
the rung-two result says nothing about rung three
REQUIRED FOR A COMPLETE INFERENCE SERVICE (NOT INCLUDED IN THIS RELEASE)
in the code the hooks are empty stubs — 'not yet fully open-sourced'
Economics: DeepSeek's own figures — revenue, not profit. The margin range is a corrected community scenario, not a measurement.
'Not included' is 'not yet'. The original margin estimate should not be repeated without its correction. Orange Tomato ran no test. Snapshot 2026-10-27.
